$comment: Implementation status for each zizmor audit ported into the workflows table. The zizmor generator is documentation-driven: it reads every audit out of the pinned docs/audits.md and fails when an audit here is unknown upstream or an upstream audit is unlisted here. Keeping status OUT of the generator means a new upstream audit shows up as a loud gap rather than silently vanishing. Values: 'implemented' — Socket runs an equivalent check; 'planned' — accepted, not yet built; 'declined' — deliberately out of scope, 'reason' required.

concurrency-limits.reason: A missing concurrency group is a cost and queue-time concern, not a security finding. Out of scope for a security scanner.

forbidden-uses.reason: Pure policy allow/deny list with no default ruleset — it only fires on operator-supplied configuration, so there is nothing to inline into a shipped table.

known-vulnerable-actions.reason: Requires a live advisory feed at scan time. Socket serves this from its own vulnerability data rather than a static table.

superfluous-actions.reason: A redundant action is a maintenance smell, not a security finding.

undocumented-permissions.reason: Style rule about comment presence, not a security property.
